name: 01835 · Haverhill, MA
findings: ZIP 01835 (Haverhill) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01835 (Haverhill) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 01835 (Haverhill) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 43% of the typical level).
